answer.justification: The layer-2 spike of 61.9 sits in the system-prompted range (31.7 – 64.0), while quantized and fine-tuned models top out at 2.8 and 6.1. Relative L2 climbs steeply from 0.294 at layer 8 to a plateau of 0.409 at layers 16 – 24 and 0.451 at layer 32, which matches the system-prompted plateau. Final cosine of 0.877 is in the 0.848 – 0.900 range, direction consistency of 0.534 is in range, and the mid-layer size ratio of 0.975 is just below 1 as expected. Onset layer 9 and effective rank 2.94 are slightly outside the stated ranges, and layer-1 L2 of 0.153 is higher than expected, but the spike and the plateau shape rule out fine-tuned, whose size ratio would be above 1.
